state_profile.voting_summary: Kentucky votes mostly on election day (61% in 2024), with three days of no-excuse early voting (31%) and excuse-required mail (6%). Polls close at 6 p.m. Eastern for most of the state (7 p.m. Central-time counties), among the first in the nation; early and absentee votes are released first and election day precincts follow quickly, with results near-complete by mid-evening. Early voting ran R+27 against R+35 on election day, so the early-heavy first reports are marginally less red than the finish.
